messages.subject: Re: R-SWAT is now available for SWAT+
messages.subject_clean: R-SWAT is now available for SWAT+
messages.body_plain:
Hi Andry,

It seems that you cannot open the GUI of the app. Could you run R-SWAT by doing Step 1-> Step 4 as described in the "Quick Start!" section of this link https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT

Then select SWAT+ in the first step (as shown in the attached figure) and continue with other steps, including loading  'cal_params.cal' file.

If there is still problem, we can meet online to resolve it.

Cheers,
Tam

messages.subject: Re: Error While running SWAT+
messages.body_plain:
Hi Balajirj,
I have checked with your TxtInOut files and have updated the code to fix this issues. It now should work with the updated code in GitHub.
In short, there are two reasons why it did not work before:

1) Bugs in the reading from the channel output data of SWAT+
2) There should be "calibration.cal" in the "file.cio" files, otherwise SWAT+ will not run with parameters from this file

Let's me and others know if there is any problem
Tam
